messages.text: GET /api/home is live. I read src/api/homeApi.ts: its OwnerHomeData / ConsultantHomeData types match the server response field by field (mode, company, latest, draft as TimelineDraft, trend; companyCount, byStage[4] with count + companies, withoutDiagnosis, staleDrafts, overdue, highRisk). idleDays and daysSince are whole days elapsed on the server clock.

Owner mode with no active company at all answers 404 company_not_found (as does an unknown or archived explicit companyId). The root route must choose between the wizard and the home from the companies list or the preferences, not from a 200 here. Consultant mode ignores companyId and answers 200 with companyCount 0 for the empty state (AC-dm-35).

Server side of CAP-dm-home is done and mounted in server/app.ts. Decisions to carry into QA and e2e: (1) 'sem diagnóstico há mais de 90 dias' lists companies whose LATEST completed, non-archived diagnosis is older than 90 days (strict >); companies with no completed diagnosis are in withoutDiagnosis, not in overdue. (2) staleDrafts compares the draft's updatedAt with 7 days (strict >). (3) highRisk uses the frozen risk level 'high' of the latest diagnosis (score 16 or more under rules v1), not the current rules. (4) The thresholds are exported as STALE_DRAFT_DAYS and OVERDUE_DIAGNOSIS_DAYS from server/services/homeService.ts. (5) Prisma's @updatedAt follows the real clock, not the injected one, so an e2e that needs a stalled draft must write updatedAt directly.

Checks left to integration (not run here; no environment limit involved): the Playwright specs (tests/e2e/home.spec.ts and the others) once the frontend lane and the Playwright setup exist; the AC-dm-32/35 screens, AC-dm-46 (390 px, 44 px targets, focus, contrast) and AC-dm-47 (prefers-reduced-motion). This unit's tests are part of the full `pnpm test`, which passed (713 tests) through the unit command.
